reason: I've never heard of this store and I can't judge a paper pendant's quality from photos. I just walked out of a showroom where I could actually see the finish, so I'm not going to spend $360 sight unseen on a no-name site.
objection: I can't tell the real build quality from photos, it's an unknown store, and if I don't like it I pay return shipping on a big fragile light. 10 to 12 business days and 6 weeks for made-to-order is also slow.
would_change_my_mind: A free sample of the material or free returns including shipping, plus independent reviews with real customer photos from a source I trust, or a bigger sale stacked on the 10% off.
